title: Apple Music to Host Free Head Trip Festival Livestream
content:
Apple Music is teaming up with Goldenvoice to livestream the Head Trip music festival that's taking place in Indio, California, on October 10 and 11.


Head Trip will feature Calvin Harris, Fisher with Chris Lake, Peggy Gou with Four Tet, Swedish House Mafia, Skrillex, Dom Dolla with Kettama, and more. Tickets to the in-person event started at $499 but have sold out, and only passes starting at $589 are available now.

HEAD TRIP. LIVE FROM INDIO. OCTOBER 10 + 11.

WATCH THE LIVESTREAM ON APPLE MUSIC. https://t.co/puQ6MSRbxA pic.twitter.com/1cAMs0xYHP

— Apple Music (@AppleMusic) September 24, 2026

Music fans who don't want to pay that much or travel to the California desert can instead watch the livestream for free through ‌Apple Music‌.
"Head Trip brings together an extraordinary lineup of artists who are shaping dance and electronic music culture right now," says Stephen Campbell, Global Head of Dance, Electronic Music & DJ Mixes at Apple Music. "Our goal at Apple Music has always been to bring fans closer to the artists, scenes, and dance floors driving this culture forward. Teaming up with Goldenvoice on Head Trip gives us an incredible opportunity to take the energy of this one-of-a-kind festival beyond Indio, giving fans around the world the chance to experience these performances on Apple Music."

Sets from the main stage of the event will be livestreamed across both days of the festival, according to Digital Music News. More information about Head Trip can be found on the festival website.
